feedback.text: Shot 1, Straighten the elbow through the snap; aim ≥ 150°. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~90°). Score 66.

Shot 6, Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~91°). Release above the shoulder; lift to ≥ 52° (now 8°). Score 64.
Shot 8, Pick the target earlier — eyes to the rim. Get the forearm more vertical at release (59° off). Score 67.
Shot 9, Release above the shoulder; lift to ≥ 52° (now 9°). Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~109°). Score 61.
